points.title: Traffic intelligence that works for scheduling
points.text: The distance matrix API supports real-time and predictive traffic: morning manifest planning with learned traffic patterns, and midday re-optimization with live congestion data.

points.title: Predictable, scalable pricing
points.text: Flat-tier pricing based on expected volume, or per-technician pricing. No surprise overage fees.

points.title: Enterprise support with a human touch
points.text: Dedicated onboarding, technical support that picks up the phone, and configuration guidance for ServiceNow use cases.

points.title: Hyper-accurate geocoding (U.S. focused)
points.text: 300+ feet more accurate for 30% of U.S. addresses, especially in multi-dwelling units, campus-style facilities and urban metros: better routing, fewer delays, more accurate ETAs.

traffic.intro: Assigning the right technician to the right job isn't just about distance — it's about time. Beans.ai gives both Predictive and Real-Time traffic data, so schedules stay accurate as road conditions change.

options.name: Predictive Traffic
options.tagline: Plan smarter for the day ahead
options.text: Machine learning on historical traffic patterns across specific geographies and times of day.
options.example: Building a technician's daily manifest at 6 AM for jobs starting at 9 AM.
options.ready: About 2–3 weeks of learning for a new metro area.

options.name: Real-Time Traffic
options.text: Live traffic conditions at the moment of scheduling or re-optimization.
best_for: Re-optimizing routes midday when delays happen
options.example: Adjusting assignments at 2 PM due to unexpected congestion.

phases.benefit: Anticipate regular patterns and avoid known bottlenecks
Account for live incidents, accidents, congestion

mix: Frequency of updates (hourly, by event, or dynamic)
traffic.plans_note: Final pricing is based on request volume, geography, and technician count.

servicenow.tagline: Smarter Routing. Lower Costs. Plug-and-Play Setup.
servicenow.intro: Beans.ai is fully integrated into ServiceNow Field Service Management (FSM), powering smarter technician assignments with flat, predictable pricing and enterprise-grade support.
servicenow.availability: Native integration with ServiceNow FSM: Scheduled Optimization from the Vancouver release, Dynamic Optimization from the Utah version.
requirements: A Beans API key to plug into ServiceNow

benefits.title: Better technician assignment
benefits.text: Optimize job-to-tech pairings with actual driving distance, not straight-line estimates.
